name: spine-upgrade-migrate-format
body: Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.upgrade-migrate-format drove only domain.value.format-migration, domain.value.library-manifest and domain.value.version; `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, so the spine dead-ended. Added `drives` -> domain.service.upgrade-project (the migrate half of `kalide upgrade`). domain.service.upgrade-project is already realised-by solution.component.upgrade. Added `implemented-by` solution.component.upgrade -> internal/scaffold.migrateLibrary, internal/scaffold.runMigrations, internal/scaffold.registeredMigrations and internal/scaffold.checkSupportedLibraryFormat (the migration framework and the unknown/newer-format refusal). Path: upgrade-migrate-format -> upgrade-project -> upgrade -> internal/scaffold.migrateLibrary. Existing `drives` to the three values kept.
